title: fagelia oblonga
intro: Fagelia oblonga, commonly known as the Fagelia, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Boraginaceae. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fagelia oblonga include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and promote wound healing, due in part to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's potential in treating various ailments and its use in traditional medicine.
